page.notes: The first marginal reference is preceded by a printed ornamental sign (a pointing hand or flourish), not a letter; it is not transcribed. The second reference "Ioā. v. 8." is uncertain in its abbreviation and numerals. The Greek word after "Sed cum" is too faint to read letter by letter, so it is marked illegible. Long s has been normalised to s and u/v/i/j to their vowel/consonant forms in the text. Two printed hyphens at line ends are kept as printed ("Princi-pum", "Ab-batum", "vsur-parint" shown as "usur-parint" after normalisation). The small marks below the last line are not text and are omitted.
